Hi! I'm **Jalapati Ravikumar** — a passionate **Full Stack Developer** from **Bengaluru, India** 📍

I specialize in building scalable, real-time web applications using the **MERN Stack**, **Java**, and **Python**. From crafting pixel-perfect frontends with **React.js** to powering robust backends with **Spring Boot** and **Node.js**, I enjoy working across the entire stack.

I'm deeply fascinated by **AI-powered applications** — currently integrating **Gemini AI & LLMs** into full-stack products and building **real-time systems** with **Socket.io**. I also work with **Docker**, **Kubernetes**, and **Azure AKS** to ship production-grade, cloud-ready applications.

I completed my **B.Tech in CSE** from Santhiram Engineering College (2024) and built solid industry experience as a **Full Stack Developer Intern at Kodnest**, delivering end-to-end features across React, Spring Boot, Node.js, and MySQL/MongoDB.
